name: Pour Some 80s on Me
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Daisy's (Miller Place) - live music calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Not to be confused with a different 'Pour Some 80's on Me' cover band from White Plains (Westchester) that also has a The Bash profile. The Bash booking profile used here is the Massapequa Park (Long Island) one; it is not linked from the band's site, so matched by name + Long Island town. The band's own site has no contact page, email or phone. Facebook page taken from The Boat Yard's artist page (not opened, Facebook needs login). The only photo is a crowd shot from the band's site with a small logo in the top-left corner.
description: Long Island cover band that plays '80s hits, from synth-pop and new wave to glam rock and power ballads, at bars, restaurants and beach clubs in Nassau and Suffolk.
